purpose: Freeze the production-quality visual target and implementation contract for S02 before production asset work or actual-root runtime replacement.
experiencePromise: Within five seconds, a first-time player understands that four cats are auto-battling an enemy, the party is climbing an unbounded tower, defeat produces rewards, and shops plus delivery support make the next attempt stronger.
informationOrder: cats and enemy in active combat
contact, attack, hit, defeat and reward causality

deliverables.name: competitive-research
acceptance: research date and at least six to ten current games
official game, store listing, official video or developer source preferred
strength, weakness, adopt, reject, Cat's Tower transformation and copy boundary recorded per game
research findings explicitly mapped to S02 decisions

deliverables.name: player-experience-definition
acceptance: purpose, five-second comprehension, protagonist, primary and secondary action fixed
required versus removable information fixed
shop support placement and failure conditions fixed

deliverables.name: information-priority-map
acceptance: every visible S02 datum classified P0 always, P1 always, P2 conditional, P3 separate screen or delete
no monetization or event item may outrank combat

deliverables.name: art-direction
acceptance: world, palette, wood, brass, metal, cloth, stone, light, shadow and depth fixed
cat and enemy proportions, render density, UI integration and effect density fixed
explicit reject criteria fixed

deliverables.name: golden-masters
acceptance: GM01 through GM08 each independently viewable on a phone
no collage-only delivery
all Japanese copy and numbers remain exact text layers
generated artwork contains no UI labels, HP, floor, currency or numeric state
every battlefield character, enemy and effect is layerable for later implementation

deliverables.name: ui-design-system
acceptance: grid, spacing, typography, numeric typography and reusable components fixed
normal, pressed, selected, disabled, locked, loading, error and cooldown states fixed
emoji and Unicode symbol icons forbidden

deliverables.name: asset-decomposition-and-animation
acceptance: background, character, enemy, UI and effect layers listed
model sheet, anchors, visible and collision bounds listed
idle, walk, anticipation, attack, impact, hit, defeat and reward reaction listed

deliverables.name: data-binding-matrix
acceptance: every runtime value has an explicit future state source
ownership, field, available and locked states are distinct
no fake active skill, reward, wallet or server result

deliverables.name: responsive-contract
acceptance: seven required viewports specified
preserve, shrink, reflow, collapse, hide and expand rules specified
battlefield minimum height, character minimum identification size, text minimum and target size specified
safe area, bottom navigation, large text and modal behavior specified

deliverables.name: implementation-feasibility-audit
acceptance: hidden background, animation consistency, scalable frames, text separation and width failure audited
asset size budgets and state coverage audited
P0 and P1 defects repaired before user presentation

goldenMasters.requiredStory: four persistent party identities, actual battlefield subset, normal enemy, floor, objective, auto state and subordinate support
same priority without uniform scaling; secondary explanation reduced before combat or targets
short-height reflow with combat still dominant
minimum supported information with scroll continuation and no clipped critical action
additional height expands battlefield and atmosphere instead of bloating UI
anticipation, strike or projectile, impact, damage, defeat and coin reward are simultaneously understandable without implying every frame occurs at one time
offline progress is pending reconciliation, shows elapsed time and provisional versus confirmed outcome honestly
on-field, owned-reserve, joinable and locked are distinguishable by label, shape and treatment, not color alone

responsiveAcceptance.bottomNavigation: five destinations, safe-area padded and thumb reachable
responsiveAcceptance.largeText: critical content reflows and secondary copy collapses; amounts and primary action never clip
responsiveAcceptance.reducedMotion: state, danger and reward remain visible through shape, label and progress

reviewRouteRequirements: DESIGN REVIEW, S02 GOLDEN MASTER and NOT RUNTIME labels
independent screen cards rather than collage-only presentation
viewport and state label on every screen
normal, causality and offline state switches
no replacement of the actual root runtime
automaticFailConditions: current runtime receives only minor CSS polish
build, CI or Vercel READY is used as the quality verdict
competitive research is absent or disconnected from decisions
Golden Masters are available only in one collage
generated Japanese text is malformed or baked into artwork
emoji, Unicode or placeholder icon remains
placeholder character, enemy, background, panel or button remains
cats are too small to identify
battle state is not understood within five seconds
fake active skill, reward or server state is shown
flattened full-screen art is planned as runtime
critical text or target is reduced below its minimum
safe area, decomposition, animation, binding or feasibility evidence is missing
user approval, Step 4 PASS, Step 5, Production Ready or physical-iPhone verification is inferred
